# Amalgamation

![Amalgamation Diagram](./images/amalgamation-explained.png)


### treatment in Accounting

- Revaluation of Assets and Liabilities - entries same as for admission or retirement
- Transferring Reserves - to old partners in old ratio
- Treatment of goodwill
  - evaluated according to the conditions of the agreement AND
  - then goodwill will open with agreed value in books
- Treatment of Assets and Liabilities not taken by new firm
  - item will get transfered to the capital accounts of partners of old firm AND closes these accounts

> [!NOTE]
> The newly formed firm is required to be get registered with the Registrar of Firms.
